add.event: Terraform Labs发行首个加密代币
add.evidence: In 2019, Terraform Labs launched its first cryptocurrency token.

add.event: Luna基金会护卫(LFG)在新加坡成立，Do Kwon任董事
add.evidence: In January 2022, the Luna Foundation Guard (LFG) was established as a non-profit based in Singapore, with Do Kwon as director.

add.event: 美国证交会以欺诈起诉Terraform Labs与Do Kwon
add.evidence: In February 2023, the SEC charged Terraform Labs and Kwon with fraud.

add.event: Terraform Labs在美国申请第11章破产
add.evidence: On January 21, 2024, Terraform Labs declared Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the United States

add.event: Do Kwon承认两项欺诈指控，同意没收1900万美元
add.evidence: In August 2025, Do Kwon pleaded guilty on two fraud charges, and agreed to forfeit US$19 million as part of a plea deal.
